text:
incident-bot: PAGER: P0 1 Elevated stream errors and gateway 5xx in us-east1 on /v1/stream. 10m error rate: 6.9%, spike starting ~02:10 UTC. Paging leo (infra oncall). Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/streaming-errors

leo (oncall): ack. entering triage channel. grabbing dashboards and recent deploys.

sarah (runtime): seeing a cluster of 'client reset while writing' and 'unexpected EOF from upstream' from gw-proxy logs. also backend model workers reporting aggressive restart loops on a few nodes.

omar (eng-sre): any deploys? deploy-bot: `deploys: none in last 2h`

leo (oncall): confirmed no prod deploys. autoscaler recently added extra runtime nodes around 02:05 but that was automated.

sarah (runtime): paste of excerpted logs for visibility:```
02:12:09 gw-proxy-5: ERROR http: upstream premature close while reading chunked body
02:12:09 gw-proxy-5: WARN http: client aborted connection (RST)
02:12:10 runtime-07 modelsrv[1223]: INFO model-worker: restarting due to OOM
02:12:11 runtime-09 modelsrv[1109]: ERROR kv_cache: failed to remap mmap +EINVAL
```

sarah (runtime): pattern looks like chunked body read fails + model worker memory churn -> upstream drops -> gateway 502s. could be a bad input causing big KV cache growth or a memory regression.

nina (support): impact: three paying customers reported streaming truncation and reconnects in the last 12m. estimated affected sessions: 1.6% global, concentrated in us-east1 zone B.

omar (eng-sre): quick repro step:```bash
# emulate client cancellation mid-stream
python -c "import requests, sys, time
 r=requests.post('https://api.redwood/v1/stream', headers={'Authorization':'Bearer $T'}, json={'model':'gpt-small','stream':True}, stream=True)
 for i,line in enumerate(r.iter_lines()):
   print(line)
   if i==2: r.close(); break
"
```

omar (eng-sre): I ran probe against runtime-07 and reproduced truncated frames. Gateway shows partial chunks followed by immediate RST to upstream. Two mitigation paths: 1) temporarily route high-traffic customers to paged endpoint, 2) flip gateway to not buffer chunked responses (proxy_buffering off) and tighten upstream timeouts/tracing.

sarah (runtime): also recommend draining runtime-07 and runtime-09 from service (they're the OOM suspects). I'll create a targeted restart and bump memory limits for the pool.

leo (oncall): performing isolation: `kubectl cordon runtime-07 && kubectl delete pod runtime-07 --grace-period=5` ; removing gw-proxy-5 from rotation now. monitoring.

ops-bot: gw-proxy-5 removed from LB pool (removed nodes: gw-proxy-5). traffic shifted across remaining proxies. health checks green.

leo (oncall): applying temporary gateway override: set `upstream_read_timeout=80s`, `proxy_buffering off`, and `proxy_send_timeout=60s` for us-east1.

omar (eng-sre): enabled edge-level streaming rate-limit: `stream_concurrency_per_key=40` for us-east1 to reduce fanout.

sarah (runtime): restarted runtime-07 and runtime-09; new pods show stable memory usage, KV remap errors not reappearing yet.

nina (support): customers confirming partial recovery: CustomerX: streaming stable; CustomerY: intermittent reconnects but reduced. overall 10m error rate down from 6.9% -> 2.0% after mitigations.

leo (oncall): good. capturing trace for an example failed session and saving logs: https://observability/trace/3842001111

sarah (runtime): notes from trace: truncated chunk header followed by client FIN within 200ms -> proxy forwarded RST to upstream -> upstream closed connection leading to 502. hypothesis: some clients aggressively cancel while proxy still buffering chunk, coupled with model worker memory pressure causes upstream drop.

omar (eng-sre): short-term action items: 1) auto-route tiered customers to paged fallback when streaming errors exceed threshold, 2) add a runtime healthcheck to detect KV mmap/EINVAL and auto-isolate, 3) reduce default streaming fanout and increase memory headroom for streaming pool.

leo (oncall): longer-term: evaluate proxy buffering strategy, add regression test for chunked streaming under client cancels, and review recent changes to mmap handling in kv_cache. open follow-up ticket: INF-4921.

nina (support): I'll send a recovery note to affected customers and offer to escalate logs for CustomerY.

deploy-bot: incident tagged: streaming-gateway-5xx -> severity downgraded to P2 (conditions improving).

leo (oncall): leaving page monitored for 90 minutes; will close if metrics remain stable. assigning owners: ops follow-up (omar), runtime investigation (sarah), customer comms (nina).

sarah (runtime): captured diagnostic dumps and uploaded to logs bucket: gs://redwood-logs/incident-3842001111/dumps.tgz ; will attach to postmortem.

omar (eng-sre): adding short mitigation checklist to runbook: quick isolate pod, temporary gateway toggles, apply paged fallback, throttle streaming fanout.

nina (support): sending note now. thanks team. :sparkles:
